targetTexts.1: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles...
targetTexts.2: Surely you have heard about the stewardship of God’s grace that was given to me for you,
targetTexts.3: that is, the mystery made known to me by revelation, as I have already written briefly.
targetTexts.4: In reading this, then, you will be able to understand my insight into the mystery of Christ,
targetTexts.5: which was not made known to men in other generations as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to God’s holy apostles and prophets.
targetTexts.6: This mystery is that through the gospel the Gentiles are fellow heirs, fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus.
targetTexts.7: I became a servant of this gospel by the gift of God’s grace, given me through the working of His power.
targetTexts.8: Though I am less than the least of all the saints, this grace was given me: to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
targetTexts.9: and to illuminate for everyone the stewardship of this mystery, which for ages past was kept hidden in God, who created all things.
targetTexts.10: His purpose was that now, through the church, the manifold wisdom of God should be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms,
targetTexts.11: according to the eternal purpose that He accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.
targetTexts.12: In Him and through faith in Him we may enter God’s presence with boldness and confidence.
targetTexts.13: So I ask you not to be discouraged because of my sufferings for you, which are your glory.
targetTexts.14: ... for this reason I bow my knees before the Father,
targetTexts.15: from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name.
targetTexts.16: I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being,
targetTexts.17: so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith. Then you, being rooted and grounded in love,
targetTexts.18: will have power, together with all the saints, to comprehend the length and width and height and depth
targetTexts.19: of the love of Christ, and to know this love that surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
targetTexts.20: Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,
targetTexts.21: to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
